purpose: Teach: ナンバーワン/しかるに/彷徨/踏み入れ/かなう/変人/親分/両足

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは家族のナンバーワンよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad is the heart of this family.
lines.style: Warm, affectionate opening. Slow, deliberate pace. Gentle certainty in her voice—not explaining, reassuring. Tender gaze, like she's telling him something important and true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、しかるにって難しい言葉まだ分からないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I don't understand that hard word yet.
lines.style: Small, careful voice. Hesitant—reaching for the words. Genuine curiosity, not complaint. A child checking that it's okay not to know.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが森の中を彷徨ったお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho — your dad says he's going to tell us a story about wandering through the forest.
lines.style: Warm anticipation in the opening. Measured, inviting pace. Voice lilts slightly on the promise of the story, drawing him in gently.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、芝生に踏み入れる前に確認するよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I'll make sure it's okay before I step on the grass.
lines.style: Determined but small. Serious intent in a child's register. Deliberate enunciation—he's making a real promise, not just playing along.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんの夢がかなう日が来ますように
lines.en: Sho — I hope the day comes when your dad's dream comes true.
lines.style: Soft, wistful openness. Gentle breathiness. A wish spoken aloud rather than a prediction. Trails off tenderly, like a prayer.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんを変人扱いしないよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I won't treat Dad like he's strange.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Protectively firm for a six-year-old. Simple and absolute—no wavering, no doubt. Spoken like a solemn vow.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家族の親分ね
lines.en: Sho — your dad is the one who leads this family.
lines.style: Affirming and secure. Steady tone, confident without being showy. Like she's reminding him of something he should know is true.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、両足の靴を綺麗にしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… I cleaned both my shoes real good.
lines.style: Eager, bright closing. Pride in a small accomplishment. Quick, light pace—he's showing off what he's done, wanting her approval.
